title: Teach plugin-migration cleanup the post-R6 hook command spelling
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/devtools/plugin_distribution.rs the recognizer at ~L473-485 only matches pre-cutover '/hooks/<name>.mjs' commands (BEE_HOOK_HANDLERS at ~L60-70), so after the R6 cutover (rendered commands invoke '.bee/bin/bee hook <name>' and contain no .mjs — pinned by hook_manifests.rs:414-433) recognized_bee_command returns false and `bee dev plugin-distribution --apply` removes nothing: a migrated host double-fires every hook. Fix: recognize BOTH spellings — mirror or share the updated onboarding recognizer in onboard/hooks_wiring.rs:131-141. Update the stale fixtures at plugin_distribution.rs ~L1343-1346, ~L1354, ~L1411 and add a regression test proving a current rendered command string (as found in this repo's .claude/settings.json) is recognized and cleaned.

truths: A current rendered hook command (no .mjs, invoking .bee/bin/bee hook <name>) is recognized by recognized_bee_command and removed by clean_hook_config
